text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye secures the Double Crown!! She 
has turned this year's Yushun Himba (Oaks) 
into an absolute legend—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters is no problem at all! Who can 
possibly stop her...! What sheer power, 
Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...! I won...!
(Ooooohh...!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa~~! Ai-chan, you're the best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: N... No waaaay...?!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What the heck is up with that kick...! 
That's way beyond just a sharp burst, 
isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's just me, but... did she pull 
ahead even more after accelerating...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, now I understand completely... 
That girl—she isn't just strong."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chaaaaaan!" "We're counting on you for 
the Triple Tiara--!" "Do your best----!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support! Please 
continue to watch over me...!

Cheeks flushed, Almond Eye didn't even try 
to hide her excitement. Something about 
how she looked caught my attention—
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦Hm?ï¼

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait a moment, Trainer. I'll be 
right back!
choice_data_list: アイ、そろそろ……
choice_data_list_en: Ai, it's about time...

text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah......!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! ...*cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: —...Still, I feel bad for Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She was strong too. The Oka Sho showed 
that as well... She's undoubtedly 
top-class among her generation.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
And yet... to have someone so leagues 
ahead of everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...She's truly in a whole 'nother league. 
A girl like that is just...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, it ain't over yet. ...Not 
yet...”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: There's still the Shuka Sho. Ai-san is...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...What am I s'posed to do? I don't have 
anything left—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I have to head back right away. So... just 
one thing!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race, thank you! 
Let's compete again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You were watching, right?! The Oaks is my 
victory too...!
choice_data_list: Congratulations!

text_block_list.text:
"—Congratulations on the Double Tiara, 
too." I kept those words to myself. For 
her, the victory itself was what truly 
mattered.
choice_data_list: おめでとう！
choice_data_list_en: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...! That was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters was definitely tough, but... 
I kept a close eye on Lara and timed my 
surge perfectly...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... Just as planned...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Huh?
choice_data_list: アイ……？

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye seemed to lose all her 
strength. I hurriedly reached out to 
support her, when—

Just to be sure, I touch her forehead 
again... It's burning hot. Body 
temperature rises after a race, but this 
is way beyond normal...!
choice_data_list_en: It's so... hooot!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh... Ugh...
choice_data_list: すみません！どなたか担架を――
choice_data_list_en: Excuse me! Someone get a stretcher—

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye was immediately rushed to the 
hospital and admitted on the spot.

Running a 2,400-meter race with almost no 
prior experience placed a massive strain 
on her, combined with her tendency to 
overheat—
choice_data_list:
(Couldn't sweat properly and came down 
with a fever...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey... How does Ai-chan look...?
choice_data_list: （うまく発汗できず、熱が出た……）
choice_data_list_en: (Couldn't sweat properly and came down with a fever...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ugh... Kh...!
choice_data_list: 今は寝てる。でも、苦しいみたいで――
choice_data_list_en: She's asleep right now. But she seems to be in pain—

text_block_list.text:
As I stepped closer, as if on reflex— Ai 
gripped my outstretched hand. Though her 
grip was weak...
choice_data_list: アイ……！大丈夫か！？
アイ……！大丈夫！？
choice_data_list_en: Ai...! Are you all right!?
Ai...! Are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Y-You okay? You look like you're 
struggling, want me to switch with you...?
choice_data_list_en: (Ah, it's hot...!!)

text_block_list.text:
There is nothing I can do right now. Even 
so, I can't just stand by and watch her 
suffer... If so, then at least—
choice_data_list: いや、大丈夫……！
choice_data_list_en: No, I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for causing trouble...
choice_data_list: （ここにいるからな、アイ……！）
（ここにいるからね、アイ……！）
choice_data_list_en: (I'm right here, Ai...!)
(I'm right here, Ai...!)

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Almond Eye woke up. 
However, her stamina seemed severely 
drained, and she had less energy than 
usual...
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, let's take our time and get 
you back in shape.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Right, of course. The most important 
thing right now is recovering... isn't it?
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、ゆっくり体調を整えよう
choice_data_list_en: Don't worry, let's take our time getting you back into shape.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"We won't be able to do hardcore training 
for a while. Even with summer training 
camp coming up..."

Tracen Academy holds a training camp every 
summer. The goal is to encourage skill 
improvement during this period when 
Umamusume are said to grow significantly.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How truly pathetic of me. Getting carried 
away by victory and squandering such an 
important opportunity...!
choice_data_list:
I didn't take good enough care of you... 
Sorry.

I didn't take proper care of you... I'm 
sorry.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No, it's not your fault...!
choice_data_list: 俺のケアが甘かったから……ごめんな
私のケアが甘かったから……ごめんね
choice_data_list_en: My care wasn't good enough... sorry.
It's because I didn't take good enough care of you... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Hey, the bandage on your hand... What 
happened?
choice_data_list: Huh? ...Ah, no... this is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. You're trying to hide something, 
aren't you?
choice_data_list: え？……あ、いや……これは……
choice_data_list_en: Huh? ...Ah, no... this is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No, tell me the truth. If you lie to me, 
I'll know, you hear?"
choice_data_list: ...Actually—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A-A low-temperature burn!? ...From my 
fever?
choice_data_list_en: ...Actually—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: T-Things like that can happen...?!
choice_data_list: その、ずっと握っていたから……
choice_data_list_en: Um, because I've been holding onto it this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —No, wait! Why didn't you let go...?!
choice_data_list:
I just wanted to help you, even if only a 
little.

I just wanted to be of help to you, even 
if only a little.
I was worried about letting go.
Because I wanted to fight alongside you.
I wanted to fight alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —No, wait! Why didn't you let go...?!
choice_data_list: 少しでも、君の力になりたくて
少しでも、貴方の力になりたくて
離すのが心配だった
君と一緒に戦いたくて
貴方と一緒に戦いたくて
choice_data_list_en: I just wanted to be there for you, even if only a little.
I just wanted to be of help to you, even if only a little.
I was worried about letting go.
Because I wanted to fight by your side.
Because I wanted to fight alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 少しでも、君の力になりたくて
少しでも、貴方の力になりたくて
離すのが心配だった
君と一緒に戦いたくて
貴方と一緒に戦いたくて
choice_data_list_en: I just wanted to be there for you, even if only a little.
I just wanted to be of help to you, even if only a little.
I was worried about letting go.
Because I wanted to fight by your side.
Because I wanted to fight alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: 君が楽になるなら、なんでもよかった
貴方が楽になるなら、なんでもよかった
choice_data_list_en: Anything was fine, as long as it gave you some relief.
As long as it took the pressure off you, anything was fine.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
I was worried it would only cause you more 
pain...

I was worried you'd end up suffering even 
more

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. But even so, there is no reason 
for you to suffer as well.
choice_data_list: 君がもっと苦しむんじゃないかって
貴方がもっと苦しむんじゃないかって
choice_data_list_en: I was worried you'd suffer even more...
I was afraid you might suffer even more

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list:
If we fight it together, you'll heal 
faster... or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Indeed. Perhaps the fever escaped 
along with it.
choice_data_list: ふたりで戦えば、治りも早い……なんて
choice_data_list_en: If we fight it together, it'll heal even faster... just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. There's no point in dawdling 
any longer, is there?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
First, prioritizing your recovery comes 
before anything else. Training can wait 
until after!
choice_data_list: Yeah, get plenty of rest.
Yeah, get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai, congrats on getting out of the 
hospital~~~~!!
choice_data_list: ああ、ゆっくり休んでくれ
うん、ゆっくり休んで
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, get some good rest.
Yeah, get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I was so lonely! We can finally sleep 
together again...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It hasn't even been a week, you know? 
Still... thank you."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Pandora-san came to 
visit while I was in the hospital, didn't 
she? I should thank her later."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do that.
Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, can Ai train now?
choice_data_list: ああ、そうしよう
うん、そうしよう
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's do that.
Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true... Little by little, I 
plan to start things up again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Still, the summer training camp is...
choice_data_list:
To be honest... I think you should sit 
this one out.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Don't worry, I understand!
choice_data_list: 正直……見送ったほうがいいと思う
choice_data_list_en: Honestly... I think you should sit this one out.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do before the next target 
race is train harder than ever before!
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, speaking of your target races...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've already decided. I want 
to aim for the Shuka Sho!
choice_data_list: そうだ、目標レースの話だけど……
choice_data_list_en: Right, about our target race...

text_block_list.text:
The final crown of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho. Looking back at her journey so 
far, it would normally be the obvious 
choice, but... she is different.
choice_data_list: But... why?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because I want to beat Lala, of course!
choice_data_list: それは……どうして？
choice_data_list_en: Why... is that?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Still, she's far from done showing what 
she's capable of. —Once she makes it 
through the summer, she'll surely come 
back even stronger.”
choice_data_list: 『オークス』でも勝っただろう？
『オークス』でも勝ったでしょう？
choice_data_list_en: Didn't you win the Oaks, too?
Didn't you win the Oaks, too?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can't put it into words very well, 
but... She's probably not at her 
strongest—right now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to beat every single 
part of her!

It seems Almond Eye senses a potential in 
Lucky Lilac that sets her apart from other 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Understood, let's aim for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Our exciting plans are coming together one 
after another! Then ai, why don't we get 
even more excited? âFood time!
choice_data_list: わかった、『秋華賞』を目指そう！
choice_data_list_en: All right, let's aim for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sounds wonderful! Hospital food was 
nutritious and all, but... right now, I'm 
craving something sweet.
choice_data_list: It's to build up stamina, so let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Looks like Trainer gave the okay... 
Shall we eat to our heart's content, 
then!"
choice_data_list: 体力をつけるためだし、食べちゃおう
choice_data_list_en: It's to build stamina, so let's eat up!
